_comment: FIXTURE install manifest for the fleet's own tests (FLEET_CONTEXT_ROOT=tests/fixtures/install).
Every value is synthetic. Every house rule differs from its fleet default, so a test can tell
a value read from here from a default; the conventions use all three value forms, people_notes
It takes the software-development skill group (templates/skill-groups.json): skills lists every
skill of the group, and the conventions name the group's skills, except branch_naming, which
points at a document of the install's own, as an install that keeps one may; workspace reads
only worktree-workflow's section 1, the rule that every write happens in a worktree.
transports.enabled names slack: load it with the registry at tests/fixtures/transports
(FLEET_TRANSPORTS_DIR, or the skills_dir argument) until the fleet tree carries the real
slack-communication/transport.json; the fixture descriptor holds the same values.
deny_list names a file that deliberately does not exist. If this fixture context ever
reaches a commit hook (FLEET_CONTEXT_ROOT left exported), the leak gate cannot read the
list and refuses the commit (exit 3), instead of running its deny half with a harmless
fixture list. A test that needs a deny list writes one under its own temporary root and
